title: Change capability URI to urn:ietf:params:jmap:chat
description:
Replace urn:kith:chat:1 with urn:ietf:params:jmap:chat throughout the codebase to match the registered IANA capability name in the I-D.

Files to touch:
- kith-jmap/src/lib.rs: Capabilities struct serde rename attribute
- kith-peer/src/lib.rs: build_peer_deliver_request and build_peer_receipt_request both hardcode the old URI in the 'using' array
- Any tests asserting the old URI string
